mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_delivery_outbox(event_id,topic,payload) VALUES(#{eventId},#{topic},#{payload}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW','RETRY') THEN 1 END) AS pending, COALESCE(GREATEST(0,trunc(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('NEW','RETRY') THEN created_at END))))::bigint),0) AS oldestSeconds, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='DEAD' THEN 1 END) AS dead FROM notification_delivery_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY','DEAD')
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',attempts=attempts+1,published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.sql: SELECT event_id,topic,status,attempts,last_error FROM notification_delivery_outbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
